assumptions.statement: 总体设计范围和三处重点区采用仓库 provisional_rough polygon；它们不构成官方红线或精确面积依据。
assumptions.statement_en: The overall design area and three key areas use repository provisional_rough polygons; they are neither official boundaries nor precise-area evidence.
assumptions.impact: 官方多边形发布后，全部几何、指标、图件、PDF、HTML和证据矩阵必须整体重算。
assumptions.trigger: 组织方发布可公开复用的正式总体与重点区 polygon
assumptions.followup_action: 替换总体与三处重点区临时边界，并统一重算几何、指标、图件、PDF、HTML、矩阵、manifest 和 self-check。
assumptions.followup_action_en: Replace provisional overall/key-area geometry and regenerate geometry, metrics, figures, PDFs, HTML, matrices, manifest, and self-check.
assumptions.current_treatment: 继续使用明确标注的 provisional_rough 几何，只作概念研究与包内复算。
assumptions.current_treatment_en: Continue using explicitly labelled provisional_rough geometry for concept study and package-internal recalculation only.

assumptions.statement: Issue #1029 记录 PROV-KEY-003 尚未锚定大钟寺站，当前不由参赛方自行平移。
assumptions.statement_en: Issue #1029 records that PROV-KEY-003 is not anchored to Dazhongsi Station; the participant does not move it independently.
assumptions.impact: 大钟寺章节按公告任务提出方向，空间落位只作为占位概念，待官方边界统一修订。
assumptions.trigger: 组织方发布可公开复用的正式总体与重点区 polygon
assumptions.followup_action: 替换总体与三处重点区临时边界，并统一重算几何、指标、图件、PDF、HTML、矩阵、manifest 和 self-check。
assumptions.followup_action_en: Replace provisional overall/key-area geometry and regenerate geometry, metrics, figures, PDFs, HTML, matrices, manifest, and self-check.
assumptions.current_treatment: 继续使用明确标注的 provisional_rough 几何，只作概念研究与包内复算。
assumptions.current_treatment_en: Continue using explicitly labelled provisional_rough geometry for concept study and package-internal recalculation only.

assumptions.statement: 容积率、建筑高度、建筑密度、绿地率、退线和四线等法定控制条件缺失。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory controls including FAR, height, building coverage, green ratio, setbacks, and control lines are missing.
assumptions.impact: 开发强度、体量和风貌均只提出方法与待核条件。
assumptions.trigger: 组织方或主管部门发布清权的正式控规条件
assumptions.followup_action: 依据正式控规补充容积率、高度、密度、退线和控制线，并复核用地与体量。
assumptions.followup_action_en: Apply official controls for FAR, height, coverage, setbacks, and control lines and recheck land use and massing.
assumptions.current_treatment: 相关指标保持 unknown/value=null；只交付决策方法，不交付法定数值。
assumptions.current_treatment_en: Keep affected metrics unknown/value=null and deliver decision methods rather than statutory numbers.

assumptions.statement: 现状建筑轮廓、年代、用途、结构安全和权属资料缺失。
assumptions.statement_en: Cleared data on existing footprints, age, use, structural safety, and ownership are missing.
assumptions.impact: 建筑图层仅为适应性更新原型，不是具体拆改留结论。
assumptions.trigger: 取得可公开/清权的建筑测绘、结构安全、用途和权属资料
assumptions.followup_action: 按测绘、结构、用途和权属资料逐栋执行保留—适配—新增决策树。
assumptions.followup_action_en: Run the retain-adapt-add decision tree building by building using survey, structure, use, and ownership records.
assumptions.current_treatment: 建筑仅作为适应性更新原型，不指认现实拆改留。
assumptions.current_treatment_en: Treat buildings as adaptive-renewal prototypes without real parcel or demolition decisions.

assumptions.statement: 道路红线、断面、轨道出入口、市政管线和交通流量资料缺失。
assumptions.statement_en: Official road redlines, cross-sections, station entrances, utilities, and traffic counts are missing.
assumptions.impact: 慢行与站城联系只表达概念连接关系，不构成工程线位。
assumptions.trigger: 取得正式道路、轨道、市政和交通调查资料
assumptions.followup_action: 复核道路红线、轨道出入口、交通量和市政容量后再确定工程线位与接口。
assumptions.followup_action_en: Confirm engineering alignments and interfaces only after road, station, traffic, and utility data are available.
assumptions.current_treatment: 只表达慢行、接驳和服务关系，不表达工程方案。
assumptions.current_treatment_en: Express walking, interchange, and service relationships only, not engineering design.

assumptions.statement: 京张铁路遗址、公园和相关文物保护范围及建设控制地带资料缺失。
assumptions.statement_en: Official heritage-protection and construction-control boundaries for the Jing-Zhang corridor are missing.
assumptions.impact: 地标与活动采用可逆、低扰动方式，需文保专业复核。
assumptions.trigger: 取得正式文保范围和建设控制资料，或项目进入真实场地设计
assumptions.followup_action: 由文保专业团队复核遗产范围、建设控制地带、材料和活动扰动，再决定落位。
assumptions.followup_action_en: Have heritage professionals review boundaries, control zones, materials, and event disturbance before siting.
assumptions.current_treatment: 所有文化装置保持可逆、低扰动，不触碰实体遗产结论。
assumptions.current_treatment_en: Keep every cultural component reversible and low-impact without making conclusions about physical heritage.

assumptions.statement: 分期表示决策顺序与依赖，不是已批准建设时序、资金安排或政府承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Phasing expresses decision order and dependencies, not an approved schedule, funding plan, or government commitment.
assumptions.impact: 每阶段须经权属、审批、安全、运营与公众程序复核。
assumptions.trigger: 场地方和运营主体书面启动真实 TG-PILOT-01
assumptions.followup_action: 在真实场地完成权属、消防、无障碍、结构、市政、排班、隐私和运营审批后，才允许进入 S0 现场基线。
assumptions.followup_action_en: Enter the S0 field baseline only after site, fire, accessibility, structure, utilities, staffing, privacy, and operating approvals.
assumptions.current_treatment: 当前只提供可撤离 MVP 契约、合成校验和退出方案；现场状态为 not_started。
assumptions.current_treatment_en: Currently provide only the removable MVP contract, synthetic checks, and exit plan; field status is not_started.

assumptions.statement: 六个全球案例仅用于提炼机制，不能证明其可直接复制或支持本项目法定控制。
assumptions.statement_en: Six global cases are used only to extract mechanisms; they do not prove direct transferability or support statutory local controls.
assumptions.impact: 所有转化建议必须通过本地试点、人工复核和专业深化。
assumptions.trigger: 场地方和运营主体书面启动真实 TG-PILOT-01
assumptions.followup_action: 在真实场地完成权属、消防、无障碍、结构、市政、排班、隐私和运营审批后，才允许进入 S0 现场基线。
assumptions.followup_action_en: Enter the S0 field baseline only after site, fire, accessibility, structure, utilities, staffing, privacy, and operating approvals.
assumptions.current_treatment: 当前只提供可撤离 MVP 契约、合成校验和退出方案；现场状态为 not_started。
assumptions.current_treatment_en: Currently provide only the removable MVP contract, synthetic checks, and exit plan; field status is not_started.

assumptions.statement: 六门校译记录的 7 条路径均为匿名合成案例；本地通过只证明规则按预期放行或阻断。
assumptions.statement_en: All seven Six-Gate Civic Proofing paths are anonymous synthetic cases; local passes verify only expected allow/block logic.
assumptions.impact: 真实场地、运营主体、公众参与、无障碍共测、安全绩效和部署授权均为空，不得从本地结果推断。
assumptions.trigger: 场地方和运营主体书面启动真实 TG-PILOT-01
assumptions.followup_action: 在真实场地完成权属、消防、无障碍、结构、市政、排班、隐私和运营审批后，才允许进入 S0 现场基线。
assumptions.followup_action_en: Enter the S0 field baseline only after site, fire, accessibility, structure, utilities, staffing, privacy, and operating approvals.
assumptions.current_treatment: 当前只提供可撤离 MVP 契约、合成校验和退出方案；现场状态为 not_started。
assumptions.current_treatment_en: Currently provide only the removable MVP contract, synthetic checks, and exit plan; field status is not_started.

assumptions.statement: 五类区域协同接口是任务书驱动的概念输入输出关系，未得到相关机构承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The five regional interfaces are taskbook-driven conceptual input/output relationships with no institutional commitment.
assumptions.impact: 不得表述为合作协议、数据共享、采购、投资或结果互认。
assumptions.trigger: 相关机构提供可公开引用的书面合作或数据授权
assumptions.followup_action: 只有在相关机构书面授权后，才把区域接口转化为合作、数据共享、采购或结果互认安排。
assumptions.followup_action_en: Convert regional interfaces into collaboration, data sharing, procurement, or mutual recognition only after written authorization.
assumptions.current_treatment: 五个接口仅表达任务书驱动的概念输入、输出和退出条件。
assumptions.current_treatment_en: Treat all five interfaces as taskbook-driven conceptual inputs, outputs, and exit conditions only.

assumptions.statement: TG-PILOT-01 的 12 米乘 6 米、72 平方米校译单元是可撤离空间原型，不绑定具体建筑或地块，也未完成权属、消防、无障碍、市政或运营审批。
assumptions.statement_en: The 12 m by 6 m, 72 sqm TG-PILOT-01 proofing bay is a removable spatial prototype, not tied to a building or parcel and not reviewed for ownership, fire, accessibility, utilities, or operations.
assumptions.impact: 任何现场试点前必须由专业团队按真实场地重新布置和核验；本方案面积不得作为建设规模或投资依据。
assumptions.trigger: 场地方和运营主体书面启动真实 TG-PILOT-01
assumptions.followup_action: 在真实场地完成权属、消防、无障碍、结构、市政、排班、隐私和运营审批后，才允许进入 S0 现场基线。
assumptions.followup_action_en: Enter the S0 field baseline only after site, fire, accessibility, structure, utilities, staffing, privacy, and operating approvals.
assumptions.current_treatment: 当前只提供可撤离 MVP 契约、合成校验和退出方案；现场状态为 not_started。
assumptions.current_treatment_en: Currently provide only the removable MVP contract, synthetic checks, and exit plan; field status is not_started.

assumptions.statement: 两名开班人员、120 秒人工接管、一个开放班次内确认撤回等均为待运营和专业团队校准的概念目标，不是已测绩效或服务承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Two open-shift staff, 120-second human handoff, and withdrawal acknowledgement within one open shift are concept targets for operator and professional calibration, not measured performance or service promises.
assumptions.impact: 真实基线、排班、风险等级和服务复杂度到位后，目标须先校准再决定是否进入公众校样。
assumptions.trigger: 场地方和运营主体书面启动真实 TG-PILOT-01
assumptions.followup_action: 在真实场地完成权属、消防、无障碍、结构、市政、排班、隐私和运营审批后，才允许进入 S0 现场基线。
assumptions.followup_action_en: Enter the S0 field baseline only after site, fire, accessibility, structure, utilities, staffing, privacy, and operating approvals.
assumptions.current_treatment: 当前只提供可撤离 MVP 契约、合成校验和退出方案；现场状态为 not_started。
assumptions.current_treatment_en: Currently provide only the removable MVP contract, synthetic checks, and exit plan; field status is not_started.

assumptions.statement: 12 条包容性路径均为无个人数据的匿名合成用例，用于检查纸质、人工、无障碍、跨语、监护和技术日志条件是否能触发放行或重译。
assumptions.statement_en: All 12 inclusion journeys are anonymous synthetic cases with no personal data, testing whether paper, staffed, accessible, bilingual, guardian, and technical-log conditions trigger proof or retranslation.
assumptions.impact: 12/12 仅代表规则结果符合预期；不代表残障者、居民、青年、国际访客或企业已经参与、同意或认可。
assumptions.trigger: 获得真人测试授权、伦理/隐私方案和可访问场地
assumptions.followup_action: 按伦理、知情同意、补偿和无障碍研究方案开展真人共测，并以参与者反馈校准指标。
assumptions.followup_action_en: Run authorized human accessibility co-testing with ethics, consent, compensation, and metric recalibration.
assumptions.current_treatment: 12 条路径全部保持匿名合成状态，不声称真人参与或代表性。
assumptions.current_treatment_en: Keep all 12 journeys explicitly anonymous and synthetic, with no claim of human participation or representativeness.
